independentListDecision.result: 80/80 have an exact Irodori Elementary 2 spelling/reading occurrence; 1/80 also matches the pinned OpenJLPT N4 list by JMdict entry ID. These were selected for concrete travel, service, device, and food-label tasks. The 79 absent from this limited community snapshot are documented disagreements, not automatic errors or proof of JLPT level.
independentListDecision.warning: OpenJLPT is a community estimate and uses JMdict for lexical identity; it is not an official level list. Irodori membership is not evidence of JLPT level. Minna links are functional mappings only because an exact Minna vocabulary list was not available.

qualitySample.method: Predeclared stratified sample of 30/80, seven travel, eight service, eight device, and seven food-label entries, ordered within group by SHA-256 of g4-vocab-n4-batch-04:<surface>. Checked selected JMdict gloss, Vietnamese contextual meaning, original example, spelling/reading crosswalk, and lesson link.
qualitySample.result: Project-author cross-check; not independent academic review. The sample is evidence of this batch review only, not a certificate for the whole lexicon.
